name: Settings_item_Wallpaper
description: A dictionary that contains wallpaper settings. This setting doesn't support user enrollment. Available in iOS 8 and later. Starting in iOS 16 and iPadOS 17, when setting the wallpaper for the first time, both locations update. After that, you can set either location separately.

name: Settings_item_Wallpaper_Where
description:
A number that indicates where to use the wallpaper, which is one of the following values:

- `1`: Lock Screen
- `2`: Home Screen
- `3`: Both Lock and Home Screens.

  In iOS 16 and later, and iPadOS 17 and later, when you set the wallpaper for the first time, the system sets both the Lock Screen and Home Screen. After that, you can separately set each location.

name: Settings_item_Wallpaper_Image
description: A Base64-encoded image in either PNG or JPG format to use for wallpaper.
